brief:
Israeli occupation forces resumed violations of the Gaza ceasefire early Monday, Shehab Wire reported. The military conducted artillery bombardment and gunfire from tanks, armored vehicles, and naval gunboats across scattered locations throughout the strip.

The breaches included strikes in multiple zones of the enclave, according to the account. The violations represent a continuation of repeated infractions against the ceasefire agreement that governs military operations in Gaza. Tank and artillery fire punctuated the overnight hours as forces moved through different sectors of the territory, marking another round in an ongoing pattern of truce violations documented by monitors.
